headline: Nifty targets a seventh consecutive session gain despite a sharp Wall Street sell-off

headline: GE Vernova T&D stock drops amid US election jitters and AI buildout concerns
hook: US election trends rattle infrastructure supply chain
summary: GE Vernova T&D secured a high-voltage direct current order award from Power Grid, yet its stock fell. Early Democrat leads in US election trends pushed Nasdaq futures down by nearly 600 points, triggering negative sentiment. Indian retail investors tracking global electrical equipment suppliers should note how US political shifts impact supply-chain valuations.
